acceptGuardianInvite(uint256).details: Accept a guardian invitation. Guardian power is granted only after acceptance.

addDocument(uint256,string,string,uint8).details: Add document metadata and encrypted content reference.

addDocument(uint256,string,string,uint8,.details: Add document with ECIES-encrypted guardian shares.

addDocumentWithReleaseCondition(uint256,.details: Add document with explicit release condition policy.
Add document with release condition policy and ECIES-encrypted guardian shares.

applyShareRefresh(uint256,address[],stri.details: Finalizes the refresh once every current guardian has published a zero-share commitment. Stores the redistributed (re-encrypted) shares and irreversibly bumps the share epoch, invalidating all pre-refresh share material for this document.
Overload of applyShareRefresh that additionally updates the on-chain Feldmann VSS polynomial coefficient commitments to reflect the refreshed shares.

approve(address,uint256).details: Gives permission to `to` to transfer `tokenId` token to another account. The approval is cleared when the token is transferred. Only a single account can be approved at a time, so approving the zero address clears previous approvals. Requirements: - The caller must own the token or be an approved operator. - `tokenId` must exist. Emits an {Approval} event.

approveAccess(uint256).details: Approve an access request (accepted guardian only, never the requester).

approveAccess(uint256,string).details: Approve an access request and submit the decrypted key share for the beneficiary. The requester can never approve their own request; quorum therefore counts only distinct accepted guardians other than the requester.

approveAccessBLS(uint256,address[],bytes.details: Replaces O(K) on-chain verification steps with 1 single pairing check, reducing multi-guardian approval gas consumption by >70% for K=10 approvals.

approveAccessByDelegation(uint256,addres.details: Delegate submits an approval (and optional beneficiary share) on behalf      of `guardian` using a valid EIP-712 {GuardianDelegation} signature.

params.guardian: The guardian who signed the delegation.
params.signature: EIP-712 ECDSA signature by the guardian.

params.encryptedShareForBeneficiary: Beneficiary key share encrypted with beneficiary public key.
params.guardian: The guardian who signed the delegation.
params.signature: EIP-712 ECDSA signature by the guardian.

approveAccessFHE(uint256,bytes).details: Approve an access request using an FHE-encrypted share payload.      Homomorphically accumulates the share directly on-chain without decrypting.

authorizeKeeperBySig(uint256,address,uin.details: Register a Web3 Keeper (Chainlink Automation / Gelato) to relay proof-of-life      heartbeats on behalf of `vaults[vaultId].creator` until `expiresAt`, using an      EIP-712 typed signature produced off-chain by the vault creator. Anyone (typically      the keeper itself) can submit this signed grant on-chain; the signature alone      proves the creator's consent, so this never needs to be sent from the creator's      own wallet. Superseding an active grant via a fresh signature or {revokeKeeper}      immediately invalidates the previous one.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the number of tokens in ``owner``'s account.

burnAccessToken(uint256).details: Burn NFT access token. Grant invalidation is handled centrally in _update, which bumps the vault access version whenever the burner's balance for the vault drops to zero.

checkAccess(uint256,address).details: Standardized, non-reverting access check for cross-contract callers.      Encodes the access state of `user` for `documentId` as a status code so      third-party DApps can branch without catching reverts.

returns._0: code 0 = document does not exist, 1 = access denied, 2 = access granted.

computeVaultAccount(uint256).details: Computes the deterministic Token Bound Account address for a given vault NFT.

configureVaultRelease(uint256,uint256).details: Configure how long owner inactivity unlocks post-death mode.      Also computes the target block count from the inactivity period      and the current median block interval, so the block-delta gate      scales proportionally to the configured inactivity window.

configureVrf(address,bytes32,uint256,uin.details: Deployer configures the Chainlink VRF v2.5 coordinator. Passing the zero address disables VRF gating and restores legacy behavior (emergency access immediately available once mode is enabled).

createVault(string,string,address[],uint.details: Create a new vault with guardian invites. msg.sender becomes the first active guardian.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

getApprovalThreshold(uint256).details: Returns the guardian approval threshold for `vaultId`.

getApproved(uint256).details: Returns the account approved for `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

params.guardian: The guardian address whose share is requested.
params.requestId: The identifier of the access request.

getBlocksSinceProofOfLife(uint256).details: Blocks elapsed since the last recorded proof of life for a vault.

getDocumentVSSCommitments(uint256).details: Returns the current active Feldmann VSS polynomial coefficient commitments for a document.

getEmergencyUnlockSchedule(uint256).details: Returns the scheduled emergency unlock summary for a vault.

params.guardian: The guardian address whose share is requested.

params.requestId: The identifier of the access request.

params.guardian: The guardian address whose share is requested.
params.requestId: The identifier of the access request.

params.guardian: The guardian address whose share is requested.

getReshareSession(uint256).details: Returns the active reshare session summary for a document.

getTokenVault(uint256).details: Return vault id attached to token id (0 if missing/deleted).

getZeroShareCommitments(uint256,uint256,.details: Returns the full zero-polynomial commitment vector published by `guardian` for `epoch`. commitments[0] is always bytes32(0).

hasActiveAccess(uint256,address).details: Returns effective access, tied to both granted access and live vault token ownership.

hasSubmittedZeroShare(uint256,uint256,ad.details: Returns whether a guardian has submitted its zero-share commitment for the given epoch.

hasVaultToken(address,uint256).details: Returns whether user currently holds any token for vault.

initializeERC6551(address,address).details: Initialize ERC-6551 Token Bound Account support. Can only be called once to set the registry and implementation addresses.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).details: Returns if the `operator` is allowed to manage all of the assets of `owner`. See {setApprovalForAll}

mintAccessToken(uint256,address,string).details: Mint NFT access token for a vault.

ownerOf(uint256).details: Returns the owner of the `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

proposeGuardianRemoval(uint256,address).details: Propose removal of a guardian from the vault. Requires majority consensus (>50%) of guardians to approve before execution.

proveLife(uint256).details: Owner heartbeat to keep vault in live mode.

proveLifeByKeeper(uint256).details: Web3 Keeper relay of a proof-of-life heartbeat, gated on a previously      registered {authorizeKeeperBySig} grant instead of the creator's own tx.      Prevents a keeper outage or an owner who simply prefers automation from      triggering a false emergency unlock.

rawFulfillRandomWords(uint256,uint256[]).details: Entry point called by the VRF coordinator with verified randomness. Only the configured coordinator may call this; the request id must match the latest one issued for the vault and can only be fulfilled once, so neither miners nor guardians can influence or replay the resulting unlock schedule.

params.proofOfPossession: 96-byte compressed G2 Proof of Possession signature.

registerPublicKey(string).details: Reverts with `RevokedPublicKey` if the key was previously revoked as compromised.

params.publicKey: The public key string to store for `msg.sender`.

requestAccess(uint256).details: Request access to a document. Requires current ownership of a vault NFT.

revokeAccess(uint256,address).details: Revoke access from user for a specific document. If the vault has      opted into cross-chain revocation via `setCrossChainRevocationEnabled`,      also emits a broadcast payload (vaultGID, documentId, targetUser,      nonce) that a relayer can have the calling guardian sign and      forward to the linked Soroban vault via `relay_revoke_access`,      closing the window where a still-cached Stellar-side grant could      be used after this EVM-side revocation. Disabled by default so      single-chain vaults don't pay for broadcast infrastructure they      never use.

revokeDelegation(uint256).details: Instantly invalidate a previously signed {GuardianDelegation} nonce.      Only the guardian who issued the nonce can revoke it.

revokeKeeper(uint256).details: Owner revokes any active keeper authorization for their vault.

revokeKey(string,string).details: Proof of possession: only the account whose registered key equals `oldPublicKey`      may revoke it. The old key is permanently blacklisted: it can never be      re-registered and any contract call path that submits key material using it      is rejected while it remains the caller's registered key.

params.oldPublicKey: The compromised public key currently registered to `msg.sender`.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`, checking first that contract recipients are aware of the ERC-721 protocol to prevent tokens from being forever locked. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must have been allowed to move this token by either {approve} or   {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

saveGuardianSharesFHE(uint256,address[],.details: Save FHE-encrypted guardian shares for a document.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Approve or remove `operator` as an operator for the caller. Operators can call {transferFrom} or {safeTransferFrom} for any token owned by the caller. Requirements: - The `operator` cannot be the address zero. Emits an {ApprovalForAll} event.

setBeneficiary(uint256,address).details: Owner-supplied beneficiary wallet address used to route emergency/post-death notifications. Settable once per vault; there is no update path by design.

setDocumentReleaseCondition(uint256,uint.details: Guardians can update an existing document release condition.

setDocumentVSSCommitments(uint256,bytes3.details: Sets the initial Feldmann VSS polynomial commitments for a document. Callable by vault guardians or creator.

setEmergencyJitterWindow(uint256,uint256.details: Vault creator tunes the jitter window Delta_T used to scale the VRF offset: T_random = VRF() mod Delta_T.

setEmergencyMode(uint256,bool).details: Owner can toggle emergency mode for rapid release workflows. When VRF is configured, enabling emergency mode additionally requests verifiable randomness; EMERGENCY_ONLY documents stay locked until the VRF-derived unlock time is reached (see {rawFulfillRandomWords}).

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: ERC-165 interface detection.      Returns true for the {ISpooVault} interface id in addition to the      standard ERC-165 and ERC-721 identifiers provided by {ERC721}.

tokenURI(uint256).details: Return token URI from storage mapping.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. WARNING: Note that the caller is responsible to confirm that the recipient is capable of receiving ERC-721 or else they may be permanently lost. Usage of {safeTransferFrom} prevents loss, though the caller must understand this adds an external call which potentially creates a reentrancy vulnerability. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. Emits a {Transfer} event.

returns._0: bool True if the signature is valid, unexpired, unrevoked, and guardian belongs to vault.

approveAccessBLS(uint256,address[],bytes.notice: Approves an access request via off-chain aggregated BLS threshold signature in a single transaction.

approveAccessDelegated(uint256,address,u.notice: Approves a document access request on behalf of a guardian using a valid EIP-712 delegation.
Approves a document access request with beneficiary key share on behalf of a guardian using a valid EIP-712 delegation.

getBeneficiary(uint256).notice: Returns the beneficiary wallet address configured for `vaultId`, or the zero address if unset.

getBeneficiaryKeyShare(uint256,address).notice: Returns the encrypted beneficiary key share submitted by a guardian for an access request.

getEncryptedGuardianShare(uint256,addres.notice: Returns the encrypted guardian share stored for a document/guardian pair.

getFheAggregate(uint256).notice: Returns the on-chain aggregated FHE ciphertext for an access request.

getFheBeneficiaryShare(uint256,address).notice: Returns the FHE-encrypted share submitted by a guardian for an access request.

getFheGuardianShare(uint256,address).notice: Returns the FHE-encrypted share stored for a document/guardian pair.

getGuardianBLSKey(uint256,address).notice: Fetch registered BLS public key and Proof of Possession for a guardian.

getMedianBlockInterval().notice: Returns the median block interval (seconds) derived from the         ring buffer of recent block timestamps. Resistant to single-block         timestamp spoofing because one manipulated sample is diluted by         the surrounding honest samples in the median.

getTargetBlocks(uint256).notice: Returns the target block count required for post-death unlock         of `vaultId`, computed as inactivityPeriod / medianBlockInterval.         This scales the block-delta requirement proportionally to the         configured inactivity period instead of using a fixed constant.

getVaultAccessVersion(uint256,address).notice: Get the current access version for a user in a vault.

getVaultGID(uint256).notice: Returns the stable cross-chain identifier for an EVM vault.

isKeyRevoked(string).notice: Returns true if the given public key has been revoked as compromised.

registerGuardianBLSKey(uint256,bytes,byt.notice: Registers a BLS12-381 G1 public key with Proof of Possession for a vault guardian.

registerPublicKey(string).notice: Registers the caller's ECIES/X25519 encryption public key.

revokeKey(string,string).notice: Revokes a compromised public key and atomically rotates to a new one.

setCrossChainRevocationEnabled(uint256,b.notice: Opt a vault into (or out of) cross-chain revocation broadcasting.         Only the vault creator may toggle this; leave disabled (the         default) for vaults with no linked Soroban counterpart so         `revokeAccess` doesn't pay for broadcast infrastructure they         never use.

vaultGID(uint256).notice: Globally-unique cross-chain identifier for a vault, derived from         this contract's address and the local vault id. A Soroban vault         links itself to this id via `link_cross_chain_vault` so relayed         revocation broadcasts can be routed to the right vault.

verifyDelegation(address,address,uint256.notice: Verifies an EIP-712 typed data guardian delegation signature.
